meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 GitHub 作为消息渠道接入:复制并注册 GitHub 适配器、安装固定版本依赖、运行构建和测试;随后通过 webhook 接收 PR 与 issue 评论,被 @ 时用专用机器人账号在线程中回复。
howto.when: 当 GitHub 仓库的 PR 或 issue 评论中有人 @ 机器人账号时触发;首次 @ 后线程被订阅,后续评论都会响应。配置流程在你要求添加 GitHub 渠道时启动。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 渠道接入进来
say.note: 会执行复制适配器、注册、安装依赖等步骤,并询问仓库类型。

say.text: GitHub 仓库是私有的,按私有方式配置
GitHub 评论没触发机器人,帮我排查

howto.what_en: Adds GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK: copies the GitHub adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds and tests. The agent then responds to @-mentions in PR and issue comment threads using a dedicated bot account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment on a monitored repo; after the first mention the thread is subscribed and all follow-ups get responses. Setup runs when you ask to add the GitHub channel.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs the Apply steps and asks about repo type.
